items.quote: the five men went into Micah’s house and took the idol, the ephod and the household gods
items.contrast: The five men initially took the ephod from Micah’s house, whereas the priest took it afterward and went with them.
items.reason: The later statement that the priest took the ephod makes him a plausible alternative, but the word “before” requires tracking the sequence and uniquely identifies the five men.
